summary: This experimental RFC extends OLSRv2, a routing protocol for wireless mesh networks, so one network can maintain several separate routing topologies at once. It stays interoperable with OLSRv2 routers that do not support the extension. It also updates RFC 7188 and RFC 7631 by changing their TLV registries and descriptions.

eli5.summary: Imagine one town with separate road maps for cars, bikes and buses. This lets wireless routers keep several maps at once, while old routers that only know one map still work fine.
